figurative_meaning_en: Money or funds collected by force or coercion
example_sentences_in_bangla: জমিদারের তোলা আদায়ের জন্য গ্রামবাসীদের উপর অত্যাচার চলছিল।
পুলিশের তোলা নেওয়ার অভিযোগ উঠেছে স্থানীয় বাজারে।
example_sentences_in_english: The zamindar's forced collection caused oppression on the villagers.
Allegations of police extortion have surfaced in the local market.
history: Refers to the forced collection of taxes or tolls (tola) during the zamindari system in colonial Bengal, often involving coercion by landlords or officials.
note: This idiom draws from historical practices of revenue collection in rural Bengal.
